name: Skyclad
description: '''Skyclad''' is an English [[Heavy metal music|heavy metal]] band heavily influenced by [[Folk music|folk]]. They are considered pioneers of [[folk metal]]. The term "skyclad" originates from a pagan/[[wicca]]n concept referring to [[skyclad (Neopaganism)|ritual nudity]], where rituals are performed with participants metaphorically clothed only by the sky, symbolising equality. The name reflects both the band's religious inclinations and their social beliefs, as expressed in the song "Skyclad" on their debut album.
